news.title: Arsenal considers renewing their interest in World Cup winner
news.lede: Arsenal remain interested in signing Nico Williams , a player they have seriously pursued since the summer of 2024. The Gunners have continued to monitor his situation and have not given up on the possibility of bringing the winger to the Emirates Stadium.Williams helped Spain win the 2026 World Cup and remains one of the most highly regarded players in world football. His performances have reinforced his reputation as one of the best wingers of his generation, making him an attractive target for clubs looking to strengthen their attacking options.The Spaniard signed a ten-year contract with Athletic Club, a commitment that appeared to make a move away from the club unlikely. However, Arsenal have refused to abandon their interest and continue to regard him as an important transfer target.

news.title: Bozza’s warning as coach weighs up big Socceroos decision
news.lede: Mark Bosnich has called for Football Australia to “roll the contract over” and keep Tony Popovic in charge of the Socceroos for at least another 12 months. It is unclear if Popovic has led the nation for the final time as a manager, with his contract set to expire in late January when the Asian Cup was originally scheduled. Popovic took the Socceroos to the round of 32 at the World Cup. Due to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, the tournament was postponed to December 2027 and Popovic has yet to ink a deal to remain in charge until then.
